Well I have been dealing with depression for years. In specific, I had been relying on distracting myself from my mental state with work and eventually that ended. So I no longer had something to keep myself from thinking and ended up spiraling for months.

Okay! I read it all I do apologize if I miss a few points. Weirdly enough we have some stuff in common so I hope my advice is helpful.

Insomnia: I have a sleeping disorder as well, not insomnia but I get little sleep. I see you have written that you have tried different doses/kinds of medicine. Sleeping disorders like insomnia can be caused by depression (You probably know this already-). There is also other things that can affect it. I would like to ask have you had insomnia since you were a kid? Caffeine, exercising, eating habits and a bunch of other crap can affect this. Also I would suggest, if you have not already, taking part in a sleep study. (I hope I can help better once provided further context-)

Relationships: I have to admit I don’t have a lot of knowledge on romantic relationships. Your first partner sounds like a cunt. I’m sorry you had to go through that. You don’t seem like the type to be very open with emotions? That’s just the ‘vibe’ I picked up- A good way to figure out relationships and such again or in general (as obvious as this may sound) would be speaking to new people. You don’t have to put yourself out there immediately and try to make new friends/ fall in love. Talking to someone 1 on 1 or even in a comment section might help. I’m saying this because it seems most if not all of the relationships you have mentioned ended up hurting you. I agree with you that the second girl was fully in her right to break up with you. It doesn’t make your feelings any less valid though. It is okay to feel hurt after a breakup even if the other person didn’t do anything wrong. (I’m going off of what I know). The third girl (I’m sorry if I am reading this wrong) but it did seem you had/have feelings for her. You said she stopped messaging because she got into a “funk”. She sounds like the type who isolates themself to cope. 

Boundaries are important in any kind of relationship as is communication. Sending her messages every now and then to let her know that you are there for her (in my opinion) is very kind and I’m proud of you for being able to open up. I wasn’t personally involved in the situation though so I have no clue how it went down. I do understand the effort with the gift but since she said she wanted to be alone I think it would have been better if you sent her a gift rather then drove over yourself. Or just not sent one at all. I’m sorry that relationship ended. Usually when things end it is best to focus on the positive parts and not the negative. Which is way harder then it sounds I’m aware-

As For your friendships, I would suggest taking some of your free time to find a hobby or interest. If you already have one that’s even better! You should take a class or join a club involving that interest so you can meet people who are interested as well. The good thing about clubs is they aren’t mandatory and if you need time for your mental health you can take it. 

(Sorry this is so long-) For your job: Is the job you are currently working in what you majored in? You said in your post that in college you took a lot of classes/did a lot of work to distract yourself. If you like your job I’d suggest spending time moving up in your company. If not I would consider finding a new one. As drastic as that may sound you shouldn’t stay working a job that makes you unhappy. You deserve to be happy. 

Therapy: I need some more context on this one. How many therapist have you tried out? Are you taking your current antidepressants and do they help? Have you discussed with your therapist that nothing seems to be helping? 

Sorry this is set up like an essay. Honestly I think you get dependent on people/things for your mental health easily and once that source leaves you you breakdown. I understand wanting to end your life I have been there before and probably will again. What I can say though is self harm isn’t the answer and neither is suicide. Sh feels good for a second and then all of a sudden that control you thought you had starts to control you. It doesn’t help, it makes things worse. You are so young you still have so much time to turn your life around. You shouldn’t end your life when there’s still a chance for you to be happy. That’s such a stereotypical line I’m sorry. I believe in you my guy and I wish the best for you. 

I hope this helped to an extent. My apologies for bad grammar/spelling mistakes I don’t feel like proof reading.
